items.title: Meta fined $567m in largest child safety ruling against social media giant
items.description: The ruling is in addition to $375m in fines Meta was already ordered to pay in the case, for a total of $942m.

items.title: Trump again tries to limit US birthright citizenship with new executive orders
items.description: The executive orders ban birth tourism and expand the existing definition of people whose children are not eligible for US birthright citizenship.

items.title: Uefa says boycott may still go ahead as FA withdraws Infantino support
items.description: Fifa's backing of president Gianni Infantino at a meeting on Wednesday "changes nothing", says European governing body Uefa.

items.title: Australian aviation crew carries out daring midwinter Antarctica rescue
items.description: Team evacuated a patient from McMurdo Station after landing plane in total darkness and temperature of -43°C.

items.title: Trump denies US weapons shortage and says information 'leakers' being 'hunted down'
items.description: While precise data is classified, publicly available information suggests the US has used up many difficult-to-manufacture weapons.

items.title: Thousands of migrants still in Ceuta after border crisis, local leader says
items.description: The Spanish territory's mayor-president also says 100 deaths occurred as a result of 78,000 migrants crossing from neighbouring Morocco.

items.title: South Korea space agency shares Moon images after SpaceX rocket debris crash
items.description: Seoul's lunar orbiter captured images of the Moon before and after part of SpaceX's rocket hit its surface on Wednesday.

items.title: Two people convicted in relation to death of French streamer
items.description: Raphaël Graven, 46, died in August 2025, with his death live broadcast on the streaming platform Kick.

items.title: Israel charges settler over killing of Palestinian involved in Oscar-winning West Bank film
items.description: Yinon Levy is charged with reckless manslaughter over the July 2025 shooting of Odeh Hathaleen.

items.title: Doge overstated claims to have saved Americans $110bn, watchdog finds
items.description: A review of the body formerly charged with reducing government spending has found several issues with its calculations.

items.title: Trump imposes 15% tariff on key chip material to counter China
items.description: The move  aims to protect US firms as they face increasing competition from China's chip industry.

items.title: Ukraine hits two oil refineries deep in Russian territory
items.description: Ukraine's president says the strikes aim to limit revenues Russia "used to finance" its war.
